value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim preschool levels - their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am and winter opens Dec 1 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville has 3-5 year old swim in 12-week sessions and Goldfish Swim School is $32.50 per 30-min lesson, no day posted. I'll keep watching and text you when I have more.
